sideA.text:
Havens have been in trouble for a while. Old records (attached) show that the four main labs were never meant to go beyond 50 years. Nor were the supplies. Our leaders have been putting on a good show for a long time now. They knew the end was near. Now they are gone and it's a race between us and the Hollow Men.

We need to find the havens outside the Atlantic... they might have supplies or equipment we can use.

sideB.text:
YEAR 57 SUMMARY

PEARL was on the verge of a cure when it went silent.

OPAL, JADE, and TOPAZ are set up to support PEARL – they are not equipped to find a cure on their own.

Transporting a potential cure from PEARL to JADE was always going to be a frantic dash. We must keep the routes between them viable.
sideB.footer: Keep papers like this in the reserve.
